name: HERACLEUM SPHONDYLIUM
key_symptoms: Pain with inclination to vomit. Bitter risings and taste. Hungry but unable to eat. Abdominal and spleenic pain.
Aches, with drowsiness, worse moving in open air, better tying up head with cloth. Much fatty perspiration on head and violent itching. Seborrhśa capitis. Sick headache.
